response.original_title: Scenic Rail Journeys of the Americas: The Canadian Rockies & The Adirondack
response.overview: You'll ride the rails on The Skeena from the charming Rocky Mountain town of Jasper to the quaint fishing village of Prince Rupert Harbor. Along the way you'll cross 191 bridges, wind your way through 14 tunnels and see countless tranquil lakes and tumbling waterfalls. You'll step off the train to take a thrilling helicopter ride above glittering Glacier Fields. You'll visit an enchanting Kitwancool village renowned for intricately carved totem poles. You'll span the continental divide with magnificent views of Mount Robson, Canada's highest peak - and more.  Climb aboard The Adirondack for a ride through one of the most historic and beautiful regions in the United States, along the fabled shores of the rolling Hudson River. You'll round the bend to witness stunning serenity from the famous Adirondack Mountains to charming Montreal in Canada's Quebec Province!
response.title: Scenic Rail Journeys of the Americas: The Canadian Rockies & The Adirondack
